assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's one curated REVIEWED item at basis_commit, read end to end with its front matter: the canonical character monograph series/fx-fighter-kurumi-chan/characters/tsukimori-kizuna-manga.md (FXK-P021, version 1.0, 69,095 bytes, status canonical, empty supersession arrays, veto false), a self-contained portrait of Tsukimori Kizuna within the Japanese collected manga main narrative to V10 i0156 (24 April 2017), located by volume and page occurrence (Vnn iNNNN) and by the project's episode, claim, forecast, checkpoint adjudication and open-item IDs, with brief Japanese quotations. She appears only on the last seven story pages of V09 and in the five chapters of V10, with one dated 2016 flashback. Her interior is reached through her own first-person narration at home, momentary inner lines and thought balloons (V10 i0109-i0114), which the portrait keeps apart from her public speech. Its publication note records an independent self-containment PASS and a fidelity PASS after revision. The volume readings, the decision and evidence ledger, the checkpoints, Studies B and C and the audits it cites are not curated on this subject, and no claim rests on them directly. The qualification record keeps her QUALIFIED_PENDING at moderate confidence after its character specialist recommended deferral; neither that label nor the portrait's COMPLETE_AT_BOUNDARY outcome was adopted as a grade. No primary source page was inspected for this assessment.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Three weeks of April 2017 in located states: Monday 3 April (V09 第45話 and V10 第46-47話: arrival, the welcome party, learning that Kurumi was wiped out but not its scale); Friday 7 April (第48話: the daily invitation to Nana, the business departure with Mochiko); Friday 21 April (第49話: the morning ritual and narration at home, the euro short); and Monday 24 April (第50話: the morning after the vote, Nana's debut, the カリフラワー proposal and Nana's plea, ending at V10 i0156). Her five years of investing and the 24 June 2016 profit are disclosed history that belongs to her at every state; V10's interiority is disclosure, not change, and the portrait finds no development. The euro short's outcome and anything after V10 i0156 are outside scope.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution) and the owner's A/B boundary direction of 24 November 2026 in PR #694, not yet recorded in the policy: A turns on the integration, individuation and transferability of the model within a declared scope; interpretations that predict the same behavior may coexist; divergent transfer conditions, missing evidence and unsettled dispositions are named and excluded rather than counted against the tier; held-out validation, analytical derivation, relationship labels and preserved source chronology are not barriers. Evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Section 2 gives an organizing account: ease performed in company and rank measured in private, net worth as the means by which she confirms her existence (her own word, 存在, V10 i0109), a goal ladder that moves as it is climbed, and ordinariness as her one named fear (i0110). Section 3 separates two kinds of decision: with people she yields when refused (the hug, V09 i0157; Nana's daily no, i0062), while with a market she waves doubt off and frames every branch as acceptable (i0119-i0124). The account predicts her misreadings as well as her generosity: a 1億 loss called impossible beside the person who made one (i0035), a lesson on greed given without knowing the scale (i0045), and possibly a belief that Nana already holds カリフラワー, though her '私も' may mean only that she too will buy a stock and the portrait keeps both readings (i0154; section 11, reading 5). Not B: the evidence does not establish which of the live motives (loneliness for fellow traders, confirmation of the frame in which she measures herself, pleasure in teasing) decides her conduct where they would diverge; the portrait abstains on recruiting where she would gain and keeps contingent self-worth and a playful ritual as rival readings of her one stated idea (section 11). The market half of the account rests on one entered trade and a recollection. Not D: the two-register account and the people-versus-market split carry located counterconditions that support narrow prediction.

Section 9 finds no development across the three weeks. What moves is circumstance and knowledge, all dated: her total by 21 April, the euro short, learning of Kurumi's wipe-out on 3 April and of Nana's debut on 24 April, a possible false belief about Nana's holding (the portrait keeps the reading that '私も' means only that she too will buy), and the first startle at i0156. Her 2016 profit and five years of investing are disclosure. Not C: no located change of her own state. Not E: the states are dated across four story days, and her knowledge state at V10's end is mapped (section 1).

Section 5 gives individuated, multi-instance rules: 私 throughout; ちゃん with a given name or nickname for every junior (くるみちゃん, いなごちゃん, ばななちゃん); casual speech to everyone shown, polite forms only in self-introductions and her report of passing ten million (V09 i0158; i0016, i0047); endings 〜よ〜, 〜ね〜, 〜でしょ〜?, 〜かな〜♡ and 〜もん / 〜だも〜ん, a pout in 〜のにぃ〜, beside a womanly layer of わ, あら〜 and そうね〜; slogans with dotted emphasis (自・由・億!, i0022), tag questions, invitations put as questions, short dismissals, certainty markers, market slang and the launch idiom (発射ぁ〜♪, i0122); blunt verdicts to a newcomer's face (i0019). The inner register is separately characterized as cool, in complete sentences without lengthened vowels or hearts (i0109-i0114), and the plain startled register appears once under Nana's plea (i0156). Not A: three weeks of lines; delivery is lettering, not a performed voice; four lines rest on placement and one exclamation is not used as hers. Not C: the rules are located per listener and across three interior channels and constrain illustrative written Japanese closely.

Section 4 gives a located working day (the asset app before the mirror at home, soy latte in a raccoon mug, a chart on her monitor, trading and personal browsing during working hours, a business departure with the president, cheek-squeezing Inago as relief, an early Monday arrival, a taxi home) and a preference table separating stable habits (soy latte for anti-aging, the raccoon motif, the morning check) from single instances (drinks after work, a pricier venue when the company pays). Not B: three weeks, mostly at the office; food beyond the latte and the party, leisure, friends and family contact are not shown. Not D: several habits are located and marked stable across scenes.

Section 6 gives directed, dated states: toward Inago, affection, instruction and a stated teasing urge, stopping at once when asked (V09 i0157; i0019-i0051, i0112, i0144); toward Nana, a cheerful daily recruiter unaware of her resentment, later reassurance and the use of her fandom as market information (i0041-i0062, i0146-i0156); toward Kurumi, a polite surface over private contempt, with a lesson on greed given inside a knowledge boundary she did not create (i0007-i0046, i0113-i0114, i0121); toward Mochiko, one light compliance (LOW, i0063); toward Yasuko, no exchange. Not B: the conditioning is sampled among three junior female colleagues over three weeks; the president is one exchange, and the profile notes no evidence for an older newcomer, a man, a superior in conflict, friends or family. Not D: each relationship has located states and a stated mechanism (affection, unawareness, the knowledge boundary).

Three interior channels differ from her public manner: reflective first-person narration at home (net worth as the routine that confirms her existence, not yet in the top 1%, i0109-i0110), momentary inner lines at the office (affection, the urge to tease, a reserved judgment of Kurumi, i0112-i0113) and thought balloons (Kurumi must be 'よっぽど下手クソ', i0114), plus one line spoken alone ('凡人止まりだわ', i0110). Not B: two pages of narration and a few office thoughts in one week; that interior does not reach her motives for recruiting, teasing or pleasure in falls, and none is given for the morning after the vote (i0138-i0141). Not D: the access is direct, located and contrasts with her speech.

Her conflict is teasing and bluntness, not quarrel: jibes at Nana, Inago and Kurumi (i0051, i0019, i0121), yielding when stopped without retreating from her view (V09 i0157; i0037-i0040), and cheerful daily invitations without immediate escalation or penalty, which Nana nonetheless resents and asks Yasuko how to stop (i0062, i0064, i0089). Under Nana's plea she drops into a plain startled question, and what follows lies beyond V10 (i0156). Not C: no quarrel, sustained opposition or escalation is shown, so the modes have no tested range under real conflict. Not E: the yield-without-retreat pattern recurs across three scenes.

Positions are implicit and located: an easy attitude toward company money that the checkpoint holds only as a low-moderate hypothesis (i0012, i0051); a light moral on greed given in ignorance of its scale (i0045); a reassurance that she is not mocking Nana's hobby (i0149); the use of a colleague's fandom as market information without asking, read as small appropriation rather than deception (section 6); and recruiting that brings her no shown gain (i0062). Not C: no weighing is shown and no principle is stated beyond the greed lesson. Not E: several stances are located with their contexts.

Teasing and self-mockery with located function: the envy jibe at Nana (i0051), calling herself 下っ端 (i0016), the mock pout when Kurumi names 投資 first (i0028), slogans and dotted emphasis (i0022, i0152), market slang (i0120, i0122), and play with Inago together with the stated urge to tease her (i0112, i0144). The portrait places this at curiosity, teasing and private judgment and keeps the comic-trait versus cruelty question open, with no act of harm shown (section 11, reading 2). Not B: three weeks of instances, and the motive for the teasing is unresolved. Not D: style and function are characterized across scenes.

One dedicated, independently reviewed portrait covers every appearance (the last seven story pages of V09, the five chapters of V10 and the 2016 flashback), routes each load-bearing interpretation to page occurrences and accepted IDs (section 12), lists forty-three re-opened pages, and keeps evidence layers apart (her speech, her narration and thoughts, others' views, placement-attributed lines). Not A: the row curates only this derived item, and the readings, ledger and checkpoints behind it are not on the row. Not C: within its boundary the portrait enumerates the evidence rather than sampling it.

Affirmative bounds are located against specific overreadings: recruiting brings no shown gain, and refusals draw no escalation or penalty from her, though Nana resents the repetition (i0062, i0089); her contempt for Kurumi stays in thought (i0114); no act of harm is shown; her risk management is undisclosed rather than shown to be poor, and the euro short's outcome is unshown, with its forecasts NOT SCOREABLE (i0140-i0156); the checkpoint qualified a stronger claim that she lives alone (D-6) and holds the other-people's-money attitude only as hypothesis (B-15); an exclamation at her trade is not attributed to her (V10-U11); market slang with a sexual edge is not evidence of attraction; Nana did not borrow the launch idiom from her (D-5); her concession that France will not leave and her bet on sentiment are not a contradiction (i0119-i0121). Not A: no scoreable forecast about her is disconfirmed within V10. Not C: the bounds carry adjudication IDs and page locators.

States carry calendar placement (3, 7, 21 and 24 April 2017; 24 June 2016 in flashback), and section 1 maps what she knows at V10's end. Not A: the span is three weeks; the period of her 166,670 gain is unresolved, and the 2012 start of her investing is Kurumi's calculation, not hers. Not C: the dates are page-located and change is separated from disclosure (section 9).

conditions: Output is illustrative written Japanese, never quotation; the evidence is lettering, so no performed voice is claimed.

Public register: 私; ちゃん with a given name or nickname to juniors; casual speech to everyone shown, polite forms only in a self-introduction or a report; endings 〜よ〜, 〜ね〜, 〜でしょ〜?, 〜かな〜♡, 〜もん, a pouting 〜のにぃ〜 and a womanly わ / あら〜 / そうね〜; slogans, tag questions, invitations put as questions, short dismissals, certainty markers and market slang.
Inner register is cool, in complete sentences without lengthened vowels or hearts, and its rough judgments do not reach speech (i0109-i0114).

Interlocutors are the sampled colleagues Inago, Nana and Kurumi, and Mochiko for one light reply. An older newcomer, a man, a superior in conflict, friends or family are unsampled; any such transfer is a separate, lower-confidence condition limited to the register rules.
No speech after a large loss of her own or beyond Nana's plea (i0156).
scenario_readiness.note: The public and inner register rules constrain illustrative written Japanese with her sampled colleagues closely enough for bounded use.

conditions: A new or younger colleague, especially earnest or cute: predict diminutives, physical affection she stops at once when asked, a blunt verdict on dullness, an invitation to aim at wealth and an offer to teach investing (the profile's HIGH row).

A colleague declines to invest: predict cheerful repetition, daily, without immediate escalation or penalty on her side, and no awareness that the colleague may experience it as pressure (Nana resents the invitations, calls them a religious pitch and asks Yasuko how to make them stop, i0062, i0064, i0089); abstain where she would gain from their joining.
Someone reveals a past loss: predict curiosity about the amount, a light moral on greed and a private low opinion, with no mockery aloud; her judgment assumes ordinary scale.

A political or macro story with market consequences: predict a quick position against a colleague's chart reading, a scenario in which every branch is acceptable, certainty language and trading during work; abstain on size, stops, adding or cutting (one entered trade, i0119-i0124).

A colleague's enthusiasm for a product or franchise: predict that it is read as market information, an edge only fans have, with a proposal to buy at scale (one scene, i0149-i0155). Whether she takes the colleague to hold the stock already is open: her '私も' may mean that or only that she too will buy (section 3; section 11, reading 5), so no assumption about the other's holdings is predicted.
Include her mistakes: misreading feelings and experience, generalizing from her own success, and dismissing doubt as shallow.
Exclude her response to a large loss of her own, the euro short's outcome, her answer to Nana's plea, romance, and anything beyond the office and the market.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: April 2017 from V09 第45話 to V10 i0156 (3, 7, 21 or 24 April), with no development across it; her five years of investing and the 2016 profit are history at every state. She knows that Kurumi was wiped out and still owes tax, not the 1億 or the bankruptcy; from 24 April she knows that Nana has begun investing, and whether she believes Nana holds カリフラワー is open; she never knows that Nana resents her. Nothing after V10.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Junior female colleagues at もちもち企画 (Inago, Nana and Kurumi), whom she teaches, recruits, teases and privately judges; Mochiko as president in one light exchange. Older newcomers, men, superiors in conflict, friends and family are unsampled and are a separate, lower-confidence transfer if used at all.
setting_constraints: The もちもち企画 office, its welcome party and her flat in April 2017, with retail currency and stock trading as the manga presents them.
No account of her sales work, no large loss of her own, no outcome of the euro short or the vote, no romance, no paratext, no event after V10 i0156, and no outcome invented to settle a prediction.

scenario_readiness.note: Narrow extrapolation is supported where the portrait's operational profile gives a located precedent. Her response to her own loss, the scenario that would most discriminate between its readings, is excluded.

conditions: Office routines: soy latte in a raccoon mug, a chart on her monitor, trading and personal browsing during working hours, proposing drinks or a pricier venue when the company pays, and squeezing Inago's cheeks as comfort.
Home: the morning asset check and the mirror, shown alone (i0108-i0110); whether she lives alone is not stated.
Leisure, friends, food beyond the latte and the party, and family contact are not modeled.
scenario_readiness.note: Office and morning routines are located across several scenes; her life outside work is largely unknown.
The portrait shows implicit stances (company money, a lesson on greed, a colleague's fandom used as information) and no weighing; ethical scenarios would rest on invention.

The portrait marks her romantic and intimate psychology UNTESTED and states that nothing may be extended into a romantic or sexual profile; the メイ exchange shows how she reads people by money, not whom she desires (i0151-i0152).

Her sales work is never shown and the portrait marks her professional skill UNKNOWN; the only work scene is a departure with the president (i0063). Office conduct is covered under MUNDANE_SOCIAL and trading under CROSS_SCENARIO.

known_limits.statement: The evidence is concentrated in seven V09 pages and five V10 chapters over three weeks of story time; most operational profile rows rest on one or two scenes.
No large loss of her own is shown; the portrait abstains entirely on her response, and the outcome of the euro short is not shown, with its related forecasts NOT SCOREABLE.

Her motives for recruiting, teasing and taking pleasure in falls stay unresolved, with rival readings (loneliness, confirmation of her frame, good will, comic trait or a streak of cruelty) that the pages do not decide.

Her market decision style rests on one entered trade and a recollected 2016 profit; her five profitable years are unverified self-report, and her risk management is undisclosed rather than shown to be poor.
She does not know the scale of Kurumi's loss or the bankruptcy, or Nana's resentment and wish for her ruin; any line to them must keep that boundary.
Whether her '私も' (i0154) reflects a belief that Nana already holds カリフラワー or only an intention to buy a stock too is unsettled; the portrait keeps both readings (section 3; section 11, reading 5).
Her repeated invitations are cheerful and unescalated in manner, but Nana resents them as a religious pitch and asks Yasuko how to make them stop; Kizuna is unaware of this (i0062, i0064, i0089).

The project's character specialist recommended deferring her for little interiority, an unshown market outcome, unresolved motives and a history of a few lines; the portrait adopts those deficiencies as its scope limits.
Four of her lines rest on placement alone, and one exclamation at her trade has no fixed speaker and is not used as hers.

Her family, origin, schooling, first money, why she left 講報堂, her sales work, her leverage and the size of a 枚 on her account, her living arrangement and how she found the name カリフラワー are outside the evidence.

The V09 and V10 deep readings, the decision and evidence ledger, the checkpoints, Studies B and C and the qualification and reconciliation audits are not curated on this subject; nothing here rests on them directly.
